title: Customer-slice spillover attenuation and graceful quota reconciliation
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: On Dedicated capacity we frequently observe short bursts from a small set of customers that cause downstream KV-cache thrash and stall inference lanes for co-located customers. Existing lane quotas and hard-slicing protect throughput but result in abrupt request rejections or overly conservative reservations that waste capacity.

Goal: Implement a spillover attenuation system for customer slices that: (1) detects an individual slice starting to cause cross-slice interference, (2) applies a progressive soft-quarantine that attenuates new allocation and shapes ingress rather than immediate hard rejects, and (3) reconciles quotas gracefully once load subsides. This should preserve latency SLOs for unaffected slices and reduce tail token cost and customer-visible errors.

Scope: Proof-of-concept on a single region of a Dedicated pool; include control-plane changes for quota bookkeeping, runtime admission controller to apply graded throttles, telemetry to detect KV-cache pressure and tail-latency signals, and a reconciler to restore quotas without customer-visible oscillation.
acceptance_criteria: Progressive attenuation prototype deployed to canary Dedicated pool and gated behind feature-flag
Observed 40-60% reduction in 99th token-latency regressions for non-offending slices during spill events in canary tests
No more than 5% increase in soft-queued requests for the offending slice compared to baseline hard-reject behavior
Quota reconciliation completes without oscillation for sustained bursts up to 10 minutes
Automated integration tests for admission controller, reconciler, and metrics emitted to console dashboards
implementation_steps: Instrument runtime to emit KV-cache miss ratio and per-slice tail token latency (ENG-31209 reference)
Design admission controller API: severity levels (observe, nudge, attenuate, quarantine) and enforcement knobs
Implement graded token-bucket shaping layer in lane allocator to support attenuate behavior
Create reconciler service to perform epochal quota restores with backoff and hysteresis
Add feature flag and canary config; create automated Chaos tests that simulate spill events
Wire up Console dashboard panels and alerting rules for spillover events and reconciler failures
Run performance validation and create runbook entries for manual override (ops/playbook)
roll_out_plan: Week 1: deploy instrumentation and admission-controller in read-only mode to record decisions. Week 2: enable attenuate mode behind feature flag for 5% sample of offending-slice candidates. Week 3: expand to 25% + run load tests. Week 4: canary across full Dedicated region; if metrics meet acceptance, promote to all Dedicated pools. Feature toggles to disable automatic quarantines and switch to hard-reject fallback. Ops will be paged on reconciliation failures or >2x expected hard-reject ratio.
checklist: Design review with runtime and allocator teams
Security review (if KMS or tenant isolation code paths altered) - optional
